'''R4-F5''' was a [[Color|blue-green]] and gray [[R4-P Astromech|R4-P]] [[astromech droid]] that was permanently integrated into the [[Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon]]. At the end of the [[Clone Wars]], the [[droid]] was [[Death|killed]] along with its master on the [[planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia]] when their [[Starship|ship]] was destroyed by [[Clone Captain]] [[Jag]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge|execution]] of [[Order 66]].<ref name="Build R2 48" />

==Description==
The [[R-series]] [[astromech droid]] R4-F5 was integrated into [[Plo Koon]]'s [[Plo Koon's Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]][[starfighter]] as his [[navigator]] and [[Pilot|copilot]], and therefore only possessed a dome head instead of a full body. This dome was blue-green in [[color]], with gray panels.<ref name="Build R2 48" />

==History==
[[File:JediCommander-SWZ.png|thumb|left|270px|Plo Koon patrols escorted by three V-wings.]]
In the early stages of the [[Clone Wars]], [[Jedi]] Master [[Jedi General|General]] Plo Koon, along with the astromech droid [[R7-D4]], flew the [[Blade of Dorin]], a [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor]].<ref name="Episode Guide: Holocron Heist">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode201.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Holocron Heist}}</ref> At some point, Koon began flying a Delta-7 instead, coupled with R4-F5.<ref name="Build R2 48" />

Koon flew his Delta-7 alongside R4-F5 during the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia]] shortly before the end of the Clone Wars. The droid was destroyed along with the [[starfighter]] by Koon's [[Clone trooper pilot|clone wingmen]] upon the activation of [[Order 66]] by the [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]], [[Death|killing]] Plo Koon as well.<ref name="ROTS" />
